The dedicated Fireguard ticket captured complete provenance once, and acceptance reused it as planned.
Final browser verification measured actual control transform changes and stable foot contact rather than relying only on action labels.

risks: Stochastic grip-rest, slip, and intermediate ascent evidence comes from the accepted DM-161 live browser observations and seeded tests; the deterministic production harness verifies final work, controls, and measured falls.

Independent main merges and existing .codex/config.toml and updater edits were preserved. The current source/test/config/preview working contents match the verified integration tree. The unrelated updater correction remains unstaged and is excluded from this mascot commit.
content.summary: The mascot now aims for the highest reachable in-progress ticket, climbs through intermediate tickets, and works with a six-frame sparking drill. Climbs include short grip breaks and occasional slips; deliberate graph wiggles cause continuous falls to the first supporting ticket or the floor, followed by recovery. With no active work, he explores upward, while ordinary graph navigation and motion preferences remain intact. All six tickets are accepted, all project checks passed, and production browser evidence passed; the sprint landed as squash commit b53384c and awaits human approval.
